title: Gigabit Internet by Xfinity
description: Xfinity Gig delivers Gigabit Internet speeds up to 40x faster than basic broadband service, now with 20% more speed for the same price. Less wait means more time enjoying.

body: Go for Gig WiFi with fast, reliable speeds and get WiFi equipment and unlimited data included. Plus Peacock Premium for 2 years.
